overview.description: The Leverage Shares 2X Long ENTG Daily ETF (ENTL) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund aims to provide 2x leveraged exposure to the daily price movement of Entegris, Inc. (NASDAQ: ENTG) stock, less fees and expenses ENTL was launched on Jun 23, 2026 and is issued by Leverage Shares.

data.title: Leverage Shares by Themes Unveils Nine New 2X Single-Stock ETFs Tracking Key Players in the Technology Supply Chain
data.text: GREENWICH, Conn., June 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Leverage Shares by Themes is pleased to announce the launch of nine new 2X single-stock leveraged ETFs, available for trading beginning June 23, 2026.
